p.name: Panhandle
p.bounds: Panhandle (High Plains Mallard Management Unit): Cimarron, Texas and Beaver counties (ODWC spells it “Cimmaron”).
p.note: Ducks Oct 10 – Jan 13. Youth, veteran and military days Oct 3 and Jan 30. Central Flyway; the High Plains Mallard Management Unit.

z.name: Zones 1 & 2
z.bounds: Zones 1 & 2: all Oklahoma counties excluding Cimarron, Texas and Beaver. ODWC lists the two zones together with identical dates and its map draws no line between them.
z.note: Ducks Nov 14 – Dec 6, Dec 12 – Jan 31. Youth, veteran and military days Nov 7 and Feb 6. Central Flyway.

seasonsNote: Duck dates differ between the Panhandle and Zones 1 & 2. Teal, geese, cranes, the light goose conservation order and the other migratory birds are statewide (sandhill cranes: east of I-35 closed).

seasons.label: Light goose conservation order
seasons.note: No daily bag or possession limit; electronic calls, unplugged shotguns and shooting to one-half hour after sunset allowed. Register with ODWC (name, address, phone).

seasons.label: Sandhill cranes
seasons.note: East of I-35 closed. Federal sandhill crane permit required.

rules.d: One-half hour before official sunrise to official sunset, unless otherwise provided (ODWC).
Federally approved non-toxic shot is required for ducks, mergansers, geese and coots statewide.

Public-land waterfowl blinds are daily blinds only: temporary blinds or stands removed at the end of each day’s hunt; a camouflage boat counts as a temporary blind; no cutting living vegetation (OAC 800:25-1-2).

Ten ODWC refuge portions (Keystone, Canton, Fort Gibson, Lyndol Fry at Hugo, Wister, Vann’s Lake at McClellan-Kerr, Red Slough, Hackberry Flat, Lake Ellsworth, Harold Stuart at Deep Fork) are closed to all access Oct 15 – Jan 31 (no entry). They are the red areas on the map.
Each WMA has its own rules (OAC Title 800:25-7); check the area before you hunt. Some WMA boat ramps close for the refuge season.
East of I-35 is closed. ODWC also posts WMAs and Land Access areas closed to crane hunting after whooping crane sightings.

Feb 15 – Mar 30, 2027, statewide: no daily bag or possession limit, electronic calls and unplugged shotguns allowed, shooting to one-half hour after sunset. All other waterfowl rules apply (non-toxic shot, licences, stamps, HIP).
Panhandle Oct 3, 2026 and Jan 30, 2027; Zones 1 & 2 Nov 7, 2026 and Feb 6, 2027. Youth hunters must be 15 or younger; the accompanying adult (18+) cannot hunt waterfowl.
Leave the head or one fully feathered wing on until you get home, and tag birds left with anyone else (federal rules).

licences.d: ODWC licence chart: hunting licence, HIP, State Waterfowl Stamp and federal stamp for ducks and geese. Nonresidents need a Nonresident Annual Hunting License; the 5-day licence is not valid for waterfowl.

licences.t: Oklahoma Waterfowl Hunting License / State Waterfowl Stamp
licences.d: Exempt: residents 65+, resident landowners on their own land, lifetime duck stamp holders. Not required for coots or sandhill cranes.
$25 at post offices or $29 at Oklahoma licence dealers; signed in ink. Not required for coots or sandhill cranes.
ODWC’s pages give the permit as $3 and also as free at GoOutdoorsOklahoma.com; check which applies.

geometryNote: Geometry: the Panhandle line is the Census county line of Cimarron, Texas and Beaver counties (ODWC’s duck zones map shows only the Panhandle and a combined Zones 1 & 2, with no county list beyond the three); ODWC public WMA boundaries, Land Access Program walk-in areas, WMA boat ramps and waterfowl refuge portions; USGS NHD (water; streams from NHDPlus HR) and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh); Census TIGER (outline, county subdivisions); OpenStreetMap (roads).
